entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Man, no enemies? I could get used[n]to this.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Maybe it's because she's not a criminal?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I suppose she did welcome us in here,[n]after all.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We should remain on guard though.[n]This is a pyramid, so there may be traps[n]littered around.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: So this is the true mystique of a bygone[n]era... The actual thing is miles beyond[n]any picture.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I don't think you can really call this[n]the actual thing...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Heh. Looks like our job's gonna be[n]pretty easy this time.
